scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter example-basic run build && pnpm --filter example-react run build && pnpm --filter example-xote run build && pnpm run verify:compatibility
scripts.build:basic: pnpm --filter @jvlk/rescript-css run build && pnpm --filter example-basic run build
scripts.build:react: pnpm --filter @jvlk/rescript-css run build && pnpm --filter example-react run build
scripts.build:xote: pnpm --filter @jvlk/rescript-css run build && pnpm --filter example-xote run build
scripts.dev:basic: pnpm --filter @jvlk/rescript-css run build && pnpm --filter example-basic run rescript:build && pnpm --filter example-basic run dev
scripts.dev:react: pnpm --filter @jvlk/rescript-css run build && pnpm --filter example-react run rescript:build && pnpm --filter example-react run dev
scripts.dev:xote: pnpm --filter @jvlk/rescript-css run build && pnpm --filter example-xote run rescript:build && pnpm --filter example-xote run dev
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --ignore-path=.oxfmtignore --check . && rescript format -c packages/rescript-css/src/*.res packages/rescript-css/src/*.resi examples/basic/src/*.res examples/react/src/*.res examples/xote/src/*.res examples/rescript-11/src/*.res examples/rescript-12/src/*.res examples/rescript-13-preview/src/*.res
scripts.rescript: pnpm run rescript:package && pnpm --filter example-basic run rescript:build && pnpm --filter example-react run rescript:build && pnpm --filter example-xote run rescript:build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run rescript:package && pnpm --filter @jvlk/rescript-css run typecheck && vitest --run --typecheck
